Enemy archer used bow for 4 damage.
Your thorncaller used thorns for 2 damage.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dain
dialogue.text: I suspended my patrol’s orders. These other guards answer to the Overseer. I will stand here with you until we know what happened.

dialogue.speaker: The Overseer
dialogue.text: Dain is dismissed. His truce binds none of you. Destroy the branch and break their circle before the council hears their lies.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: Bring me to the central grove. The roots kept the workers’ last memories. If I am driven out, I must begin again.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Then we defend the grove, captain included. The Overseer has given us a reason to keep listening.

dialogue.speaker: The company
dialogue.text: Lark fell. The company cannot continue without them.

campaign.outcome: Lark fell. The company cannot continue without them.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The council promised the villages repair timber. Its Overseer marked our sacred groves instead. His crews keep their tools and carts in those two forts.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Take the camps and the cutting stops. The northern post kept the workers’ records. Bring those back too.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dain
dialogue.text: My missing woodcutters were sent here. The Overseer says your pack killed them. I have orders to protect the crews that remain.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: Your orders won’t tell us where they went. Their ledger might.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: We need our roots back, not your bones. Keep away from our groves, captain, and help us find your people.
